# The Auric Solar-Host — Draft Datasheets

*Owned verb: **MARTIAL STANCES** · generated by `unit_calculator.py faction` · ×1.5 scale · stat line = MOV · MS · RS · ARM · MIGHT · CTRL*

**Core trait — Martial Stances & Solar Overdrive:** Command Phase: choose 1 Stance for the whole army this round: Aegis (incoming PEN −1) · Vanguard (ranged weapons gain [ASSAULT] and +1 to Hit within 12″) · Executioner (melee weapons gain [ONSLAUGHT 1]). HIGH RISK — Solar Overdrive (⟳ once per round, one unit, when it activates): +1 Attack on all weapons and [SHREDDING WOUNDS] this activation, but its ARM is 1 worse until it next activates.

**Gamble — Solar Overdrive** *(risk: exposure (durability))*: Once per round, one unit, when it activates: +1 Attack on all weapons and [SHREDDING WOUNDS] this activation, but its ARM is 1 worse until it next activates.

**Army-wide rules (priced into every unit):** *Stance: Aegis* — Incoming PEN −1 (chosen ~1/3 of rounds). · *Stance: Vanguard* — +1 to Hit within 12″ (~1/3 of rounds, half the shots in range). · *Stance: Executioner* — Melee [ONSLAUGHT 1] (~1/3 of rounds). · *Solar Overdrive* — Once per round on one unit. · *Overdrive cost* — ARM 1 worse after Overdrive.

## Detachment — Gilded Host

*golden guardians-style: golden elites hold the centre; every model a hero.*

**Detachment rule:** Unbroken Phalanx: Gilded units within 3″ of an objective count +1 CTRL per model; in Aegis Stance they also gain [WARD 5+] against ranged attacks.

**Enhancements**
- **Sunforged Aegis** (+20 pts, High Aurarch Praetor): The bearer has [WARD 3+] (the best ward in the game; single model only).
- **Blade of the First Oath** (+45 pts, Blade-Warden Champion): The bearer's blades: +2 Attacks, +1 Damage.

**Stratagems**
- **Alchemical Bloodline** (1 CP) — *A Gilded unit is targeted:* Incoming Damage −1 (min 1) for that attack.
- **Gilded Vigil** (1 CP) — *A Gilded unit controls an objective at the End of Round:* It keeps [SECURED] on that objective.
- **Golden Riposte** (1 CP) — *A Gilded unit is declared as a Charge target:* It gains [STRIKE FIRST] against that charger this round.

## Detachment — Gene-Forged Host

*Space-Marine-style: Sworn Battle-Brothers in numbers, Vanguard drops, tanks.*

**Detachment rule:** Oath-Doctrines: Rounds 1–2 Devastator (+1 PEN on ranged when not moving), Round 3 Tactical (re-roll Wound 1s), Round 4 Assault (+1 Attack in melee). Sworn units only.

**Enhancements**
- **Artificer Plate** (+10 pts, Sworn Lieutenant): The bearer has [WARD 4+].
- **Master-crafted Sol-bolter** (+10 pts, Sworn Lieutenant): The bearer's pistol: +2 Attacks, +1 PEN.

**Stratagems**
- **Bolter Discipline** (1 CP) — *A Sworn unit Shoots:* Its [HAILFIRE] applies at full range.
- **Sunfall Assault** (1 CP) — *Sworn Vanguard arrive from reserves:* They may Charge this activation.
- **Contempt of Iron** (1 CP) — *A Sworn unit is shot:* Incoming PEN −1 for that attack.

## Detachment — Sunfall Spearhead

*Drop-assault: Vanguard, Paladins and Lancers strike from orbit.*

**Detachment rule:** Comet Descent: [VANGUARD STRIKE] units may arrive 7″ from enemies (not 8″) and get +1 to Wound on the activation they arrive.

**Enhancements**
- **Comet Banner** (+10 pts, Sworn Lieutenant): The bearer and its attached unit gain [VANGUARD STRIKE].
- **Sunfall Brand** (+20 pts, Blade-Warden Champion): +1 Damage on the activation the bearer arrives or charges.

**Stratagems**
- **Orbital Lance** (1 CP) — *A unit arrives from reserves:* Pick an enemy unit within 12″ of it: D3 Fatal Wounds.
- **Thunderous Landing** (1 CP) — *A unit arrives within 9″ of an enemy:* That enemy gains 1 Suppression token.
- **Recall to Orbit** (2 CP) — *End of Round:* One unengaged [VANGUARD STRIKE] unit returns to Strategic Reserves.
